Maria: Quick proposal — instead of static headroom, compute dynamic headroom per pool based on p95 arrival + recent burst variance. Rough formula sketch: headroom = max(0.05, 0.5 * (burst_stddev / mean_qps))
Aj: Can you list the metric names we'll use?
Maria: runtime.pool.qps_p95, runtime.pool.burst_std_1m, runtime.pool.mean_qps_1m (sliding windows)
Toby: Main concern: tenants could game burst metrics. We need fairness and anti-abuse.
Kai: Idea: two-tier headroom. Pool-level baseline + tenant-burst overlay. Tenant overlay limited by burst credits.
Sara: For Dedicated pools we must avoid surprise preemptions of long-running inferences. How does this change eviction semantics?
Maria: It doesn't. The headroom signal only drives earlier node provisioning. Eviction still uses in-flight TTL + preemptible policy.
infra-bot: Canary rollout kicked off for pool-us-west-2 with 3 nodes at 2025-11-19T14:02:00Z
Aj: Who owns the final action — autoscaler or pool-controller? Operator boundary needs clarity.
Toby: Autoscaler should propose scaling intents; pool-controller should validate and execute. Keep controller as the authoritative applier.
Kai: Add audit events: scale.proposed, scale.applied, scale.rejected with reason codes. Makes debug + observability easier.
Maria: Also add cost guardrail: do not exceed historical baseline by >20% without a manual override.
Sara: Telemetry we should capture: proposed_delta, applied_delta, decision_latency, rejection_reasons, contributor_metric_breakdown. Attach to per-pool dashboard.
Aj: Oscillation risk: what about noisy metrics causing rapid scale up/down?
Maria: Use hysteresis + ramp caps: require 2 consecutive windows (1m each) to trigger; cap ramp-up to +30% capacity per minute; exponential backoff on failures.
Toby: Edge-case: single-tenant spike that legitimately needs throughput. Burst credits allow tenant to override up to a soft cap. Beyond that, fallback to multi-tenant fairness.
Kai: Draft for burst-credit algorithm: monthly credit budget per tenant, replenish linearly; override consumes credits; credits decayed for inactive tenants. Penalty if abused.
Sara: Ops concern: when scale flips, debugging is painful. Expose debug endpoint: /debug/pool/<id>/last_scaling_decisions (last 3) with input metrics + decision trace. Authz gated.
Aj: Sounds implementable. I'll write an RFC PR with operator boundary, decision trace spec, and the telemetry plan.
Maria: I'll include sample PromQL queries and dashboard widgets in the PR.
Toby: Also add a small chaos test: simulate a tenant spike and assert burst-credit prevents global oscillation.
Kai: For rollout, recommend slow canary: 2 pools then expand, with automatic rollback on >3 scale failures in 30m.
Sara: One more: add on-call runbook steps for diagnosing flaps and manual override procedure.
Maria: Thanks all — pushing PR now. :rocket:
